pageTitle: Sexual Harassment Prevention — Blue Seat Studios
heroTagline: Animated compliance training that actually sticks. Covers harassment, bystander intervention, and state-specific requirements for employees and managers.
coversBullets: Defining sexual harassment — quid pro quo and hostile work environment | Recognizing harassment in person, in writing, and online | Bystander responsibility and how to safely intervene | How to report — internal channels, HR, and external agencies | Manager obligations, investigations, and anti-retaliation protections
L1_desc: Every employee is entitled to a harassment-free workplace. This opening lesson sets the tone — what the course covers, why it matters, and what a healthy work environment actually looks like.
L2_desc: What does person-to-person sexual harassment actually look like? Covers the key principle that intent does not equal impact.
L3_desc: A direct, engaging way to learn about quid pro quo in workplace settings — what it looks like, why it's never okay, and how to recognize it.
